title: nice design
text: Husband loves it!  Some of the reviews concerned me, but what the heck, I went for it.  First shirt is fairly nice quality. The decal on the shirt, Discover Fleet Academy, is unique but a little scratchy looking, but maybe its supposed to look that way.  I hope its doesn't shrink and the decal stays on.  I'll try and wash in cold water, inside out and hang dry to be sure.
label: positive
